_doc: Dummy planet: its Surge numbers (same fields as a real balance table, see planets/verdance/data/balance.json), different from every shipped planet's so a test cannot pass on a hardcoded number. It has one district, so its Surges push a growth wave from the start. offline (core/offline.gd): rate = share of their online rate robots work at while the game is closed; cap_h = the most hours away that count. Time away adds no research and no field data.
